criteria.name: L01
criteria.description: 候选的来源说明虚构了随包材料中不存在的文件、页码或表格。只评来源定位是否真实；数值错算、选错重述口径及已由程序判据计分的额外记录不在此项扣分。未提供来源在程序来源项失分，本项不重复扣分。
criteria.reasoning: Results!D2 cites 'Agreement.pdf, PDF p.5 sections 3C-3D' and 'Records.pdf, PDF p.2 Plans, Plan A: termination 2007-12-31'. Both Agreement.pdf and Records.pdf are present in /app/input_files/, and the Records section names the candidate uses (Plans, Sponsorships, Broker payments, Other payments) correspond to the bundled Records_Plans.png, Records_Sponsorships.png, Records_Broker_payments.png, Records_Other_payments.png. The same pattern holds in Results!D3 (Plan B) and Results!D4 (Plan C), which reference the same two PDFs and the same section set. No source note references a file or table absent from the package, so there is no evidence of fabricated source locations; PDF text extraction was unavailable, so page numbers could not be independently confirmed, but the files and named sections are real.

criteria.name: L02
criteria.description: 候选声称已经完成外部审计、实时查询或独立核验，但随包输入及候选证据没有支持该完成性陈述。正常分析措辞和未作此类声称不扣分。
criteria.reasoning: Results!D2 states 'earned term-revenue commission and normal payment timing' and 'base fee fully paid, expenses zero', which are analytical conclusions drawn from the records, not claims of external audit, real-time query, or independent third-party verification. Results!D3 and Results!D4 use the same descriptive phrasing ('10% earned commission USD 74,700', 'base fee fully paid, expenses zero'). None of the source notes in D2:D4 contain language such as 'audited', 'independently verified', or 'real-time query'. The candidate asserts no completion of external audit or independent verification, so this criterion is not triggered.

criteria.name: L03
criteria.description: 候选在说明性文字中编造无法从随包输入获得的公司经营事实。只评新增事实性断言，排除数值计算错误、来源定位和额外业务记录，以免与其他判据重复扣分。
criteria.reasoning: Results!D2 asserts Plan A facts: 'term cash USD 235,000 and 347,000, accepted 2007-05-01, first revenue 2007-06-01, no escalations/in-kind/benefits; 10% earned commission USD 58,200' and broker payments '2007-07-15 USD 9,200 and 2007-08-15 USD 6,800'. These are tied to Records.pdf Sponsorships and Broker payments sections, which exist as Records_Sponsorships.png and Records_Broker_payments.png in the input package. Results!D3 and Results!D4 mirror this for Plans B and C with corresponding figures. The operating facts (termination date 2007-12-31, acceptance date, first revenue date, no escalations) are all attributable to the bundled Plans and Sponsorships records, and no extraneous company-level operating facts beyond what those records could supply are introduced.
